subject: Webhook endpoint receiving 500s since Tuesday deploy
body:
Since your Tuesday release our webhook consumer at https://hooks.northwind.example/helphub has been getting malformed payloads. Before the release the `ticket.updated` event looked like:

{"event": "ticket.updated", "data": {"id": 8812, "status": "open"}}

Now we get:

{"event": "ticket.updated", "data": {"id": 8812, "status": "open", "labels": [null]}}

and our JSON schema validator rejects the null entry, so our handler returns 500 and your side retries. We have now had 41 retries on a single event and the retry queue keeps growing. Stack trace from our side:

  File "/srv/app/handlers.py", line 88, in on_ticket_updated
    validate(event, TICKET_SCHEMA)
jsonschema.exceptions.ValidationError: None is not of type 'string'

We have not changed anything on our side. Can someone tell us whether the null label is intended and whether the retries can be paused for our workspace (id ws_7741) until we ship a tolerant validator? This is blocking our support team from seeing status changes in their dashboard.
